Definitions - Any capitalized terms used but not defined in this SOW will have the meaning set forth in the General Terms or elsewhere in the Agreement.  This SOW consists of the SOW Cover Page, these Additional Terms, and the SOW Schedules set forth on the SOW Cover Page.
Recitals
MSP and Customer have entered or are concurrently entering into a MSA for MSP to perform Services for Customer.
This SOW sets forth specific services that MSP agrees to provide under the Agreement.
This SOW is by reference incorporated into the Agreement and added as an Attachment.  The General Terms govern this SOW.

Only the express services set forth in this SOW become Services.  No services of any kind are implied in any way regardless of industry or trade customs and practices including, without limitation, the Excluded Services (defined below).
Term and Termination.

This SOW will commence on the SOW Effective Date and continue through the Initial Term, unless earlier terminated as provided in the General Terms. This SOW automatically renews for successive Renewal Terms on the same terms and conditions, subject to adjustments and exceptions as described in this SOW, beginning on the day immediately following the end of the Initial Term or then applicable Renewal Term, unless either Party gives the other Party ninety (90) days prior written notice (in accordance with the notice provisions set forth in the General Terms) before the end of the Initial Term or then current Renewal Term of its intent not to renew this SOW. The Initial Term and all Renewal Terms collectively constitute the “SOW Term” for this SOW only.
Fees and Payment Schedule.

Fees. Promptly following the SOW Effective Date, Customer agrees to pay the Setup Fee and, during the SOW Term, the Monthly Fee (as set forth on the SOW Cover Page).  The Monthly Fee is subject to adjustments and exceptions as described in this SOW below.  Schedule C sets forth the detailed service rates for the SOW Services, the Equipment covered under this SOW, and the process for adjusting prices when additional Equipment or new users/supported employees are added. If Customer requests additional Services under this SOW through a Service Case or otherwise, Customer agrees to pay those additional fees (“Additional Fees”).  The Setup Fee, Monthly Fees, and Additional Fees may collectively be referred to as “SOW Fees”.

Payment Schedule. SOW Fees are invoiced to Customer monthly, as applicable, and will become due and payable on the first day of each month. Customer agrees to pay all SOW Fees one month in advance. If Customer does not pay the SOW Fees in full within fifteen (15) days of the due date, or if Customer at any time otherwise fails, neglects or refuses to make timely payment of SOW Fees, MSP has the right to suspend the SOW Services and any other Services at any time thereafter.  The period of suspension will constitute Suspension Dates (as defined in the General Terms).  If MSP agrees to reconnect SOW Services or other Services, Customer will be charged fees as determined by MSP for reconnecting and reinstalling any suspended SOW services and/or Services and Customer agrees to pay MSP for such fees.

Fee Adjustments. Customer and MSP recognize that unforeseen circumstances, and changes or events beyond the Parties’ control may require adjustments to the SOW Fees.  Accordingly, MSP will notify Customer of any necessary fee adjustments which could be +/- 5%. Fee adjustments will take effect immediately upon notification. Unless there are significant ongoing market increases, MSP will limit increases to two (2) times per calendar year.
Scope; Services; Minimum Requirements.

This Schedule A and Schedule B list the services to be performed by MSP for Customer under this SOW (“SOW Services”).  MSP will not perform any Excluded Services (defined below). Additional services added to the SOW Services will incur Additional Fees.
All Equipment covered under this SOW must meet Minimum Requirements as set forth in Schedule C and/or Policies.
Coverage.

Help Desk.  Help Desk and Management of Customer’s IT networks will be provided to the Customer by MSP through remote means during Business Hours. All Services qualifying under these conditions, as well as Services that fall outside this scope will fall under the provisions of Schedule B.

Network Monitoring Services. MSP will provide network monitoring 24/7/365. All Services qualifying under these conditions, as well as Services that fall outside this scope will fall under the provisions of Schedule B.

Support and Escalation. MSP will respond to Customer’s trouble tickets with commercially reasonable efforts outside of Business Hours.  Trouble tickets must be opened by Customer’s Authorized Personnel, by email to MSP’s Help Desk, or by phone if email is unavailable.  Each call will be assigned a trouble ticket number for tracking.
Service outside Business Hours. Emergency services performed outside of the Business Hours, excluding holidays, shall be subject to the provisions of Schedule C.

Remote Support. Within a commercially reasonable time after acknowledging receipt of a trouble ticket we shall contact Customer and provide remote support in the form of consultations, assistance, and advice concerning the trouble ticket. If the issue cannot be corrected through remote support, we shall notify Customer that on-site support is required. We will then send personnel to the Customer facility for purposes of mitigating or remedying the issue. Such on-site support shall commence within a commercially reasonable time after commencing remote support.

Service Calls Where No Trouble is found. If Customer requests onsite service and no problem is found or reproduced, Customer shall be billed at the current applicable rates as indicated in Schedule C.

8x5 Onsite IT Support. If the issue identified in a trouble ticket cannot be corrected through remote support, MSP shall notify Customer that on-site support is required. MSP will then send personnel to the Customer facility for purposes of mitigating or remedying the issue. Such on-site support shall commence within a reasonable time after commencing remote support. Equipment costs of any kind are not covered under the terms of this SOW.
Additional Maintenance Services.

Hardware/System Support. MSP shall provide support of Equipment specified in Schedule B that is covered under an applicable and active support agreement; replaceable parts are readily available, and where all Third-Party Software is genuine, currently licensed and supported by the Third-Party Provider. Should any Equipment fail to meet these provisions, they will be excluded from this SOW. Should a Third-Party Provider be required in order to resolve any issues, the fees charged by such Third-Party Provider will be passed on to the Customer after first receiving the Customer’s authorization to incur them.

Monitoring Services. MSP will provide ongoing monitoring and security services of all Equipment as indicated in Schedule B.  MSP will provide regular reports as well as document critical alerts, scans and event resolutions to Customer. Should a problem be discovered during monitoring, MSP shall make commercially reasonable efforts to rectify the condition in a timely manner through remote means in accordance with this SOW and the Agreement.
“Excluded Services”. Services under this SOW do not include:
Parts, equipment or software not covered by vendor/manufacturer warranty or support.
The cost of any parts, equipment, or shipping charges of any kind.
The cost of any Software, Licensing, or Software Renewal or Upgrade Fees of any kind.
The cost of any 3rd Party Vendor or Manufacturer Support or Incident Fees of any kind.
The cost to bring Customer’s environment up to minimum standards required for Services.

Service and repair made necessary by the alteration or modification of equipment other than that authorized by MSP, including alterations, software installations, installation of APPS, or modifications of equipment made by Customer’s employees or anyone other than MSP.
Maintenance of Applications software packages, whether acquired from MSP or any other source unless as specified in Schedule B.
Programming (modification of software code) and program (software) maintenance unless as specified in Schedule B.
Training services of any kind.
All services listed as Excluded Services in Schedule B.
Unknown Devices (as defined in the General Terms)
All services not specifically listed in this SOW regardless of industry or trade customs and practices.
